title: Europe's Euclid Telescope Releases Its First Great Map of the Universe
title_zh: 欧洲欧几里得望远镜发布首份宇宙大地图数据
source_name: European Space Agency — “Euclid lays the foundation for its best-ever 3D map of the Universe” (12 Nov 2026)
summary_zh: 据欧洲空间局11月12日发布的消息，其“欧几里得”（Euclid）太空望远镜公布了首批重要数据DR1-Foundation。这批数据来自约13个月的观测，捕捉到超过10亿个天体的光，覆盖的天空面积相当于9500个满月，其中包括9亿多个星系、约1.5万个强引力透镜候选体、超过6000万个可能的类星体，以及超过1.6亿个光源的光谱，数据量达170万吉字节。这仍只约占该望远镜六年巡天计划的14%。欧几里得于2023年7月发射，目的是研究暗物质、暗能量和宇宙网，并绘制有史以来从太空制作的最大三维宇宙地图。文章还介绍了强引力透镜如何帮助“称量”星系中看不见的暗物质，以及2027年年中将补充发布的弱引力透镜结果。
paragraphs: On 12 November, the European Space Agency (ESA) released the first major set of data from its Euclid space telescope. Called DR1-Foundation, the collection captures the light of more than a billion objects across an area of sky as large as 9,500 full Moons. It is the first substantial release since Euclid was launched in July 2023, laying the foundation for the largest 3D map of the cosmos ever made from space.

Based on about 13 months of observations, it includes more than 900 million galaxies, around 15,000 candidates for strong gravitational lensing, over 60 million possible quasars — the extremely bright centres of distant galaxies — and the spectra, or rainbows of light, of more than 160 million sources. The survey covers 1,900 square degrees of sky and contains 1.7 million gigabytes of data, yet this is only about 14 per cent of the area Euclid plans to study in its six-year mission.

Euclid was built to study the 'dark Universe'. Most of the cosmos consists of dark matter and dark energy, which cannot be seen directly but shape how galaxies form and how the Universe expands. Working above Earth's atmosphere, the telescope can take sharp pictures over a wide area. By splitting galaxy light into spectra, scientists can measure distances and place galaxies in a vast structure called the cosmic web.

A highlight is the largest catalogue of strong gravitational lenses ever assembled — bigger than all earlier catalogues combined. This rare effect occurs when a closer galaxy bends the light of a more distant one, acting like a natural magnifying glass. Researchers can use it to 'weigh' galaxies, including their invisible dark matter, and to study cosmic expansion. The lenses were identified with machine learning and the help of thousands of volunteer citizen scientists.

Scientists say this is only the beginning. The complete Data Release 1, due in mid-2027, will add weak-lensing results and further maps of the cosmic web. ESA's Director of Science, Professor Carole Mundell, called the release a 'scientific milestone'. Euclid is an ESA mission with support from its member states, NASA and more than 2,000 scientists in the Euclid Consortium.
paragraphs_zh: 11月12日，欧洲空间局（ESA）发布了其“欧几里得”（Euclid）太空望远镜的首批重要数据。这批名为DR1-Foundation的数据集捕捉到了超过10亿个天体的光，覆盖的天空面积相当于9500个满月那么大。这是自欧几里得望远镜于2023年7月发射以来首次实质性的数据发布，为有史以来从太空绘制的最大三维宇宙地图奠定了基础。
这批数据基于约13个月的观测，其中包括9亿多个星系、约1.5万个强引力透镜候选体、超过6000万个可能的类星体（即遥远星系极其明亮的中心），以及超过1.6亿个光源的光谱（也就是光的“彩虹”）。此次巡天覆盖了1900平方度的天空，数据量达170万吉字节，但这仅约占欧几里得六年任务计划巡测天区的14%。
欧几里得望远镜的建造目的是研究“暗宇宙”。宇宙的大部分由暗物质和暗能量组成，它们无法被直接看见，却塑造着星系的形成方式以及宇宙的膨胀方式。由于在地球大气层之上工作，这台望远镜能够在很广的区域拍出清晰的照片。通过把星系的光分解成光谱，科学家可以测量距离，并把星系放进一个被称为“宇宙网”的巨大结构中。
此次发布的一个亮点，是有史以来汇编的最大强引力透镜目录——比此前所有目录加在一起还要大。这种罕见现象发生在较近的星系弯曲较远星系的光线时，作用就像一块天然的放大镜。研究人员可以用它来“称量”星系（包括其中看不见的暗物质），并研究宇宙膨胀。这些透镜是借助机器学习，并在成千上万名志愿“公民科学家”的帮助下被找出的。
科学家表示，这仅仅是个开始。完整的第一批数据发布（Data Release 1）预计于2027年年中推出，将补充弱引力透镜的结果，以及更进一步的宇宙网地图。欧洲空间局科学总监卡罗尔·芒德尔教授称这次发布是一个“科学里程碑”。欧几里得是欧洲空间局的任务，得到了其成员国、美国国家航空航天局（NASA）以及欧几里得联盟中2000多名科学家的支持。

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A plan to build a new ground-based telescope in Europe.
The first major data release from ESA's Euclid mission, which will help map the Universe.
A study proving that dark energy does not exist.
A decision by NASA to take control of the Euclid project.
questions.explanation: 全文围绕欧洲空间局欧几里得望远镜于11月12日发布的首批重要数据DR1-Foundation展开，介绍其规模、科学目的（绘制三维宇宙地图、研究暗宇宙）以及后续计划；并未提到要在地面新建望远镜、否定暗能量，或由NASA接管该项目。

evidence.quote: the European Space Agency (ESA) released the first major set of data from its Euclid space telescope

questions.prompt: How much of the sky area that Euclid plans to study does this data release cover?
options: An area equal to 900 million square degrees.
About 14 per cent of the planned survey area.
questions.explanation: 第二段明确指出，这次巡天覆盖1900平方度、数据量达170万吉字节，但这仅约占欧几里得六年任务计划巡测天区的14%。选项A把观测时长误当成覆盖比例；选项B和D都与原文数字不符。

evidence.quote: yet this is only about 14 per cent of the area Euclid plans to study in its six-year mission

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about strong gravitational lenses?
options: They can only be found by telescopes on the ground.
Scientists already had a larger catalogue of them before this release.
They help researchers study material that cannot be seen directly.
They were all discovered by Professor Carole Mundell.
questions.explanation: 第四段说明，强引力透镜可以用来“称量”星系，包括其中看不见的暗物质。由此可以推断，它们能帮助研究者研究无法直接看见的物质。文中还指出这是有史以来最大的该类目录，并且透镜是借助机器学习和公民科学家找到的，因此A、B、D都不成立。
